messages.subject: Summer Stats Camp 2018
parts:
blavaan community

This June we are having the Summer Stats Camp in Albuquerque, New Mexico. With 15 week long courses offered. Multiple courses offering support for R, and multiple SEM focus courses with lavaan example code and support

I am teaching the Bayesian SEM course, with example code and support on blavaan

Week 1, June 4-8
1. Introduction to Social Network Analysis R and Rsiena
2. Latent Class Analysis
3. Multilevel Modeling
4. Psychometrics
5. Program Evaluation
6. SEM Foundations
7. R programming for Data Science

Week 2, June 11-15
8. Adavance SEM: Bayesian SEM
9. Bayesian Data Analysis
10. Longitudinal Mixture Modeling
11. Longitudinal SEM
12. Mediation and Moderation
13. Meta-Analysis
14. Multilevel SEM with xxM
15. SEM with Mplus

Find the detail at 
https://www.statscamp.org/summer-camp

Hope to see some of you there

-- Mauricio
